components.name: LandingPageList
uxRules: Table Layout: Use a strict grid or set min-widths for columns (Title: 30%, Slug: 20%, Pixels: 20%, Status: 15%, Actions: 15%) to prevent cramped text.
Alignment: Vertical-align middle for all table cells. Left-align text, center-align Actions.
Destructive Action Guard: onDelete MUST trigger a confirmation modal (Preview-before-apply) before executing the deletion.
Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA): Ensure the external link icon (Slug column) and Action icons have sufficient contrast against the dark background.
Empty State: Display a clear 'No landing pages found' message with a primary button to create one when landingPages array is empty.
components.description: Renders the list of landing pages in a data table. Standardizes layout spacing, alignment, and implements a safety guardrail for deletion.
